items.title: Dave Liebman — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Here’s an interesting Ed Sarath date, Voice of the Wind. [INTERVIEWEE] Is that Billy and JoAnne?

ctx.x: meets launeddas. We did India. We did Richie’s Elm. They arranged three different cats to play launeddas to play the chords. That’s a kind of interesting record, folky type thing, ethnic.
Then you – there’s a follow up. The same dates, it says, all for – the label is called Nueva. It’s an Italian label. Here’s an interesting Ed Sarath date, Voice of the Wind.
